PASS: The write-up leaves multiple risks explicitly open/unresolved — e.g., the export-control binarity and hyperscaler-mix deceleration are used to argue a materially lower judgment valuation without being neutralized, the terminal-value dominance is flagged as a genuine structural sensitivity rather than resolved, and the wide dispersion between DCF scenarios is explicitly left as "genuinely wide range" deferred to separate comps work rather than closed out.

PASS: Both parts name the archetype (software_saas) with confidence and stated basis, and justify the primary method (multi-stage FCF DCF for an asset-light SaaS business; forward P/E/EV/EBITDA/P/S as relevant multiples given intangible-heavy, recurring-revenue model) with explicit reasoning, not just assertion.
